lead: These questions test workplace words: documents, payments, travel and finance. Pick the word whose exact meaning matches the situation, and check the structure it needs.
這類題目考職場用詞：文件、付款、差旅與財務。要選確切意思符合情境的字，並檢查它需要的句型。
steps: Find the situation: who pays whom, what is being sent, and when.
先找出情境：誰付錢給誰、寄什麼、什麼時候。
Match the situation to a term. Ask what the word names: a document, a payment, a person or an action.
把情境對應到術語。想想這個字指的是文件、款項、人，還是動作。
For verbs, check the preposition that follows (deduct from, reimburse for, reconcile with).
遇到動詞，要檢查後面的介系詞（deduct from、reimburse for、reconcile with）。

head: Documents: each one has its own job
文件：各有各的用途
body: An estimate gives a price before work starts. An invoice asks for payment. A receipt proves payment was made. An itinerary lists travel plans. An agenda lists meeting topics. Match the job to the sentence.
estimate 在開工前報價；invoice 請對方付款；receipt 證明已付款；itinerary 列出行程；agenda 列出會議議題。把用途對到句子上。
ex: The garage sent an estimate before it started the repair.
修車廠在開始維修前先寄了估價單。
Keep the receipt as proof that you paid.
請保留收據作為已付款的證明。
The agenda for Monday's meeting has six items.
星期一會議的議程有六項。

head: Money terms: when and why it is paid
金錢用詞：何時、為何付款
body: A deposit is part of the price paid early. A premium is what you pay for insurance. A deductible is what you pay first in a claim. A rebate returns part of the price after purchase. A surcharge is an extra fee.
deposit 是先付的部分款項；premium 是保險費；deductible 是理賠時先自付的額度；rebate 是購買後退回部分款項；surcharge 是額外費用。
ex: Guests must pay a deposit and the balance on arrival.
房客須先付訂金，餘款於抵達時付清。
The policy has a low monthly premium but a high deductible.
這份保單月保費低，但自負額高。
Buyers can claim a rebate on energy-efficient models.
購買節能機型的買家可申請退還部分款項。

head: Money verbs and the words after them
金錢動詞與後面接的字
body: Deduct A from B. Reimburse a person for an expense. Reconcile one record with another. Absorb a cost means to pay it yourself instead of passing it on.
deduct A from B；reimburse 人 for 費用；reconcile 一份紀錄 with 另一份；absorb a cost 是自行吸收成本，不轉嫁給別人。
ex: Payroll deducts the parking fee from your pay.
薪資部門從你的薪水中扣除停車費。
The firm will reimburse staff for hotel costs.
公司會補還員工的住宿費用。
Our supplier agreed to absorb the shipping cost.
我們的供應商同意自行吸收運費。

head: People and roles in a business
商業中的人與角色
body: A creditor is owed money. A debtor owes money. An investor puts money in to earn a return. An auditor checks the accounts. A supplier or vendor sells goods to the company. Decide who owes and who is owed.
creditor 是被欠錢的人；debtor 是欠錢的人；investor 投資求回報；auditor 查核帳目；supplier、vendor 是供貨給公司的人。先分清誰欠誰。
ex: The company paid its creditors before the end of the year.
公司在年底前還清了債權人的款項。
An outside auditor will review our accounts in May.
外部審計員將在五月審查我們的帳目。

head: Lose, waive or return: the condition matters
失去、免除、退還：看條件
body: Forfeit means to lose something because you broke a condition, such as a deposit. Waive means the other side chooses not to require something. Refund means to give money back. Redeem means to exchange a coupon or voucher for value.
forfeit 是因違反條件而失去（如訂金）；waive 是對方自願免除要求；refund 是退還款項；redeem 是把優惠券或票券兌換成價值。
ex: Guests who cancel late forfeit the deposit.
太晚取消的房客會喪失訂金。
The bank agreed to waive the transfer fee.
銀行同意免收轉帳手續費。

head: Use the nearby words as clues
用周圍的字當線索
body: Words like payment, order, proof, per month, balance or claim point to a specific term. Read them first, then pick the word that names that exact thing.
payment、order、proof、per month、balance、claim 這類字會指向特定術語。先讀這些線索，再選指稱該事物的字。
ex: Send the invoice by the 5th, and payment follows within thirty days.
請在 5 號前寄出請款單，我們會在三十天內付款。
Check your inventory before you place a new order.
下新訂單之前，先確認庫存。

pairs.right: The company will reimburse employees for travel expenses.
pairs.wrong: The company will reimburse employees of travel expenses.
why: Reimburse a person for an expense. Of does not fit.
reimburse 人 for 費用，不用 of。

pairs.right: Taxes are deducted from your monthly pay.
pairs.wrong: Taxes are deducted to your monthly pay.
why: The structure is deduct A from B.
句型是 deduct A from B。

pairs.right: Keep your receipt as proof of payment.
pairs.wrong: Keep your estimate as proof of payment.
why: A receipt shows payment was made. An estimate only gives a price in advance.
receipt 證明已付款；estimate 只是事先報價。

pairs.right: The bank is our largest creditor, and we owe it money.
pairs.wrong: The bank is our largest debtor, and we owe it money.
why: The side that is owed money is the creditor.

head: Money verbs and patterns
金錢動詞與句型
items: 報銷、補還某人某筆費用
使 A 與 B 相符
就某款項向某人開請款單

traps: Words from one field look alike in Chinese. Premium, deposit and deductible are all 費用 in a loose sense, but each names a different payment. Match the situation first.
同一領域的字在中文裡看起來很像。premium、deposit、deductible 都像「費用」，但各指不同款項。先對應情境。
A verb can fit the meaning and still fail on its preposition. Check deduct from, reimburse for and reconcile with before you choose.
動詞意思對，介系詞可能不對。選之前先檢查 deduct from、reimburse for、reconcile with。
Do not mix up the two sides of a transaction. Ask who pays and who receives: creditor and debtor, lender and borrower, supplier and customer.
不要把交易的兩方搞混。問清楚誰付、誰收：creditor 與 debtor、lender 與 borrower、supplier 與 customer。
